readings.title: What does the Creed contain, and where did it come from?

paragraphs.text: Philaret connects the Creed with the councils of Nicaea in 325 and Constantinople in 381. A council is an assembly of Church leaders concerned with doctrine and church order; ecumenical refers here to the councils recognized as speaking for the whole Church. The catechism divides the Creed into twelve articles so that each subject can be explained in turn, from God the Creator to everlasting life.
